changelog:
Initial release of ahrefs-mcp skill.

- Provides real-time access to Ahrefs SEO data via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Supports keyword research, backlink analysis, domain/site audits, content exploration, rank tracking, and competitive analysis
- Guides users on setup, usage workflows, and common SEO analysis tasks
- Includes instructions for handling missing MCP connections and managing API usage limits
- Emphasizes actionable insights, best practices, and efficient query design for effective SEO analysis
summary: Access Ahrefs SEO data for site analysis, keyword research, backlink and competitor insights, rank tracking, and technical SEO audits via MCP integration.
